jei.config.client.search.creativeTabSear: Match creative inventory tab names only when % is typed first, like %building.
Do not search creative inventory tab names.
jei.config.client.ingredientList.toastRe: Move Ingredient List Away from Toasts
Move the top-right ingredient list when a toast notification appears, so the toast does not cover it.
Move the ingredient list when toasts appear.

jei.config.client.search.centerSearch.de: Choose where the JEI search bar appears.
jei.config.client.recipes.recipeGuiHeigh: Limit how tall the recipe screen can grow.
jei.config.client.recipes.recipeGuiWidth: Preferred recipe screen width. The screen expands when a recipe needs more room. Drag its edges or corners to resize it.
jei.config.client.recipes.navigationMode: Choose how to move through recipes within a category. Categories always use pages.
Use page buttons to move through recipes.
Use the mouse wheel or scroll bar to move through recipes within the selected category.
jei.config.client.recipes.maxRecipeGuiCo: Limit how many columns of recipes can appear when the recipe screen is wide enough. Drag its edges or corners to make room for more columns.
jei.config.client.cheating.cheatToHotbar: Allow cheating ingredients into hotbar slots.
Do not cheat ingredients directly into hotbar slots.
jei.config.client.cheating.showHiddenIng: Show ingredients that are hidden from the creative inventory.
Hide ingredients that are not in the creative inventory.
jei.config.client.recipes.description: Options for recipe pages and recipe lookup behavior.
jei.config.client.recipes.appearance.des: Options for recipe screen size and ingredient animations.
jei.config.client.recipes.showTagRecipes: Show recipe pages for tags, so recipes that accept a group of ingredients can show every matching ingredient.
jei.config.client.bookmarkList.addBookma: Choose where newly added bookmarks appear in the bookmark list.
jei.config.client.bookmarkList.bookmarkO: When true, pressing the bookmark key on a recipe's output will bookmark the recipe instead of the ingredient.
jei.config.client.bookmarkList.dragToRea: Allow bookmarks to be reordered by dragging them in the bookmark list.
Allow bookmarks to be reordered by dragging.
Keep bookmarks in place while dragging.
jei.config.client.bookmarkList.bookmarkT: Show a small recipe preview when hovering over recipe bookmarks.
Show recipe previews on recipe bookmarks.
Hide recipe previews on recipe bookmarks.
Show the ingredients needed to craft a recipe bookmark.
Show ingredients needed by recipe bookmarks.
Hide ingredients needed by recipe bookmarks.

Show extra bookmark details only while the configured key is held.
jei.config.client.tooltips.showCreativeT: Show creative inventory tab names in ingredient tooltips.

jei.config.client.tooltips.tagContentToo: Show matching ingredients for recipe tags.

jei.config.client.tooltips.hideSingleTag: Hide tag contents when there is only one matching ingredient.
Show tag contents even when there is only one matching ingredient.

Show a quick summary of ingredients needed for a recipe when hovering over the recipe output.

Hide the ingredient summary on recipe outputs.

Only look up recipes for the item itself.

Only use item tags when looking up block items.

jei.config.client.lookups.maxColumns.des: Limit how many columns of recent lookups are shown.
jei.config.client.lookups.maxIngredients: Limit how many recent lookup ingredients JEI remembers.
jei.config.client.lookups.displaySide.de: Choose the side of the screen that shows recent lookups.
jei.config.client.advanced.lowMemorySlow: Use less memory for ingredient search. Searching will be slower.
Use less memory and search more slowly.
Use normal search speed and memory.
jei.config.client.advanced.catchRenderEr: Show an error placeholder instead of crashing.
Let ingredient drawing errors crash the game.
jei.config.client.ingredientSorting.desc: Options for ordering ingredients in JEI's ingredient list.

jei.config.client.recipes.recipeSortingB: Show recipes for bookmarked ingredients before other recipes.
Keep bookmarked recipes in the normal order.
jei.config.client.recipes.recipeSortingC: Show recipes with available ingredients before recipes with missing ingredients.

jei.config.client.lists.drawBackground.g: Show a panel background with a grid of ingredient slots.
